name: Hime no Rakuen
source:
Since successfully developing powerful magic, the empire has continued to wage wars against neighboring countries to expand its territory.

Due to something as a dividing line, the empire's princess Canaria and her attendant Iora were driven to live in an isolation hut.

In her boring daily life, Canaria accidentally saw prisoners of the neighboring knights being brought into the city.

So, Canaria said to her father, the emperor──

[b]"I want that person."[/b]

The princess's life trajectory intersects with the hearts of the two men.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2765080/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
自从成功开发出强大的魔法以来，帝国不断向周边国家发动战争，扩张领土。

由于某种分界线的原因，帝国的公主加那利和她的侍从伊奥拉被迫住在隔离小屋里。

在无聊的日常生活中，卡纳利无意中看到了邻国骑士团的俘虏被带进了城市。

于是，加那利对她的父亲皇帝说道——

[b]“我想要那个人。”[/b]

公主的人生轨迹与两个男人的心相交。

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2765080/]Steam[/url]]
